name: animated-list
title: Animated List
description: Adds its children one at a time, newest on top, with a springy push. Shows everything at once under reduced motion.

props.name: children
props.description: The items. Each needs a stable key. The newest item appears on top.

props.name: interval
props.description: Seconds between one item appearing and the next.

props.name: delay
props.description: Seconds before the first item appears.

props.name: loop
props.description: Start over after the last item, instead of stopping.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Shows every item at once with no animation.
